Medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot on a 35mm lens, composed for 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) stands at the black stone bathroom sink, weight settled toward the vanity, holding a sealed coral lipstick carton in one hand while the other hand hovers ready to tear it open. A smartphone rests beside the chrome faucet in the near foreground, visibly vibrating but ignored. Compact downtown apartment bathroom, glossy white wall tile, mirror above the basin, pale gray minimal surroundings. Hard directional morning sunlight cuts a crisp stripe across the tile and sink, with sharp reflections and airy neutral shadows. Modern social-first beauty product photography, tactile editorial energy, handheld micro-movement, clean true-to-life color, vivid coral accent.
